A near-palatial '''house''' stood in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate bestowed the house upon one of his many former [[Unidentified ex-mistress|mistresses]] as a going-away present upon ending the relationship with [[Gender/Legends|her]].
